hero.eyebrow: A historic bed and breakfast in North Augusta
hero.title: A Southern mansion, *turn-of-the-century charm*
hero.lede: Fifteen rooms with antique furnishings and private baths, five of them in the historic mansion itself. Breakfast is included, parking and WiFi are free, and SRP Park is about a mile away.

image.alt: Lookaway Inn: a white-columned Southern mansion under a live oak, beside a glass conservatory

facts.label: Rooms, each with a private bath

items.title: 215 Magnolia
items.text: The mansion’s master bedroom and our premier room: king bed, spacious quarters, separate sitting area and a large tub.

items.title: 210 Mulberry
items.text: Queen, in the historic mansion, with bay windows and a view of the camellia garden and courtyard.

items.title: 211 Camellia
items.text: A spacious queen in the mansion, with a view of Calhoun Park and Georgia Avenue.

items.title: 214 Capital
items.text: A corner queen in the mansion with a large private bathroom; a favorite for brides getting ready.

items.title: 212 Ginger
items.text: The mansion’s petite queen, with the best views of North Augusta and Calhoun Park.

items.title: 110 Hawthorne King
items.text: Antique furnishings, a jetted tub and first-floor access. Our guests’ favorite: book early.

items.title: 114 Laurel King & 115 Cypress Queen
items.text: First-floor ADA rooms: Laurel has a roll-in shower; Cypress has a ramp and handicap parking close by.

items.title: 219 Gardenia & 220 Rosemary
items.text: Connecting upstairs rooms, two queens and a queen, ideal for families and friends traveling together.

items.title: Double queens & more
items.text: Primrose, Garden (with a jetted bath), Veranda and Jasmine (a king or two twins), plus the cozy Wisteria queen.

sections.title: Southern hospitality, *since 2017*

image.alt: A twin room with two beds dressed in navy and plaid

body: Innkeepers John and Mary Felak have run Lookaway Inn since 2017. Every room is air conditioned, with a private bathroom and a flat-screen TV, and breakfast is included with every stay.
You are in the heart of North Augusta, with easy interstate access and close to Augusta, Georgia. Free private parking is on site, and WiFi reaches the whole property.

items: A conservatory feel, flooded with natural light

items: A corner room in the mansion for getting ready

items: Home of the Augusta GreenJackets, about a mile away

items.a: Yes, breakfast is included with every stay.
Yes. 114 Laurel King has an ADA bathroom with a roll-in shower, and 115 Cypress Queen is on the first floor with a concrete ramp and handicap parking.

items.q: Can a group book rooms together?
items.a: Yes. 219 Gardenia and 220 Rosemary connect, and several rooms have two queen beds. Rollaway beds are available.

items.q: Can we hold our wedding here?
items.a: Yes, at Camellia at Lookaway Inn. Call (803) 221-2044 for pricing and availability.
